data.title: Meta Platforms COO reports sales of 1,466 shares | META Insider Trading
data.summary: Meta Platforms, Inc. (META) Chief Operating Officer Javier Olivan reported transactions involving sales of 1,466 Class A shares at $600 per share on November 23, 2026. data.title: Meta settlement may fail to curb teen social media use without industry-wide rules
data.summary: The research letter, published Wednesday in the medical journal JAMA, examines the potential impact of a multistate settlement requiring Meta to pay up to $17 billion and implement restrictions on its platforms. Researchers found that Instagram and Facebook account for only about 20% of teenagers’ daily social media use, while competing platforms, including Snapchat, TikTok and YouTube, account for the remaining 80%. [...] Three months after Meta reached an over $17 billion settlement with a coalition of states to resolve allegations that its social media platforms harmed children and teens, a new study co-authored by Seattle Children’s researchers says that without the implementation of industry-wide time limits for kids and teens using social media, the payout may fail to make an impact on overall social media use. [...] The study concluded the settlement requiring Meta to change its social media platforms may have limited effect on teenagers’ social media use unless other major platforms adopt similar restrictions, according to a new study co-authored by a Seattle Children’s researcher. Washington was among the states involved in the lawsuit, which accused Meta of designing features that encouraged compulsive social media use among children and teenagers.
